part.text: Now I have all the information needed. The `frpm` table has enrollment data and the `schools` table has address info. Both share `CDSCode` as join key.

input.sql:
SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS K12_Enroll, f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS Age5_17_Enroll, f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS Diff
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
ORDER BY Diff DESC

**Evidence SQL:**
```sql
SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS K12_Enroll, f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS Age5_17_Enroll, f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS Diff
```
